label: Terminate infra
description: Delete a copy of an infra node and its disk: the program's own copy, or with `instance` that instance's copy of a `@per_instance` node. The triggers whose cut contains the copy go down first as `door` and `held` say, and come back once it runs again; `running` decides about the runs using it.

inputs.name: node
inputs.description: The infra node, named as the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file): a shared one when `instance` is unwired, one marked `@per_instance` when it is set.

inputs.name: instance
inputs.description: Whose copy: an instance id your program gives it (`user-42`), for that instance's copy of a `@per_instance` node. Unwired: the program's own copy. Wired, and no id arrives (the node feeding it did not run): this node skips.

inputs.name: door
inputs.label: Door
inputs.description: What happens to work arriving at the triggers whose cut contains the copy while they are down: take holds it for when they are back (a question stays listed for the people who answer it), hide holds it out of their sight, refuse takes nothing.

inputs.name: doorForMinutes
inputs.label: Door for minutes
inputs.description: With take or hide: the door refuses once this many minutes have passed. Unset: it holds until the triggers are back.

inputs.name: held
inputs.label: Held work
inputs.description: The work already held on them (events held while they were down, runs they fired that are paused on a wait): keep it for when they are back, or drop it, cancelling the paused runs.

inputs.name: running
inputs.label: Running work
inputs.description: The runs going right now that use the copy: wait keeps the copy up until they end, however long that takes, cancel stops them.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: On: this run is cancelled too when it is one of the runs reached.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the triggers reading the copy are down and the delete is handed off (or the copy was already going); the copy is deleted afterwards.

outputs.name: noCopy
outputs.description: True instead of `done` when the copy does not exist: it was never started or was terminated before, or the instance id names no instance that has one. Wire it to tell whoever asked.

then.message: TerminateInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no infra node of this program marked `@per_instance`. It is given an `instance`, so it acts on that instance's copy: name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file), or leave `instance` unwired to act on the program's own copy of a shared one.

TerminateInfra '{id}' names {names} in `node`, which is no shared infra node of this program. It has no `instance`, so it acts on the program's own copy: name one the way the program writes it (`bridge`, `work.bridge` inside a group, or `one.bridge` inside an included file), or wire `instance` to act on an instance's copy of a `@per_instance` one.
TerminateInfra '{id}' refuses what arrives and sets `doorForMinutes`, which only counts down a door that takes or hides work. Pick take or hide for `door`, or leave `doorForMinutes` unset.
